subject: Azure Marketplace private offer — Northstar Analytics discount request / deal desk review
messages:
From: Marco Rossi <marco@azure-partner.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ana Li <ana.li@northstaranalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Azure private offer + co-sell credit for Northstar

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Northstar (Ana Li) is ready to move forward but they asked for a private offer via the Azure Marketplace to align procurement. They are targeting a 12-month commitment and want a 35% off list price on the marketplace SKU to make the economics work on their end.

I've attached the preliminary quote and the listing details (Azure requires the private offer to be created with the discounted price). Can you route this to deal desk / pricing for approval? We expect co-sell enablement on Azure, so they will also want the seller’s co-sell discount applied where required.

Quick details:
- Customer: Northstar Analytics (Ana Li)
- TCV (list): $220k ARR equivalent (12mo)
- Requested marketplace discount: 35%
- Workload: Redwood Hosted API with dedicated support
- HubSpot deal: HS-34242 (link below)

Attachments: Northstar_Quote_2026-04-10.pdf, Azure_Listing_Details.xlsx

Appreciate a quick turnaround — they’d like to finalize by next Thursday.

Thanks,
Marco
Partner Sales Manager | Azure Marketplace Partnerships
Azure Partner Network
From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>
To: Marco Rossi <marco@azure-partner.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Azure private offer + co-sell credit for Northstar

Marco / Ana — thanks for the details. Looping in Marissa (sales lead) and Karthik (pricing & deal desk) to review.

Two quick questions for Karthik and Marissa:
1) Is 35% off-list within our standard marketplace private-offer guardrails, or does this trigger a special approval?
2) Any additional co-sell paperwork Azure expects from our side to get the co-sell credit?

We’re trying to balance enabling the ACV while preserving unit economics — if we can approve a concession tied to a committed usage or a Dedicated commitment, that helps. I’ll leave the pricing guidance to you.

Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Azure private offer + co-sell credit for Northstar

Sean / team — reviewed the quote and the ask. Notes below:

Summary:
- Requested: 35% off list on marketplace private offer
- List TCV: $220k for 12 months
- Standard marketplace cadence: we typically allow up to 20% on Marketplace private offers for standard PLG-led accounts; 25-30% requires a deal-desk exception depending on strategic value.

Commercial impact:
- 35% would drop our gross margin below threshold for Hosted API unless we attach a usage SLA/commitment (e.g., min monthly spend or Dedicated reservation).

Suggested path forward (two options):
A) Approve up to 30% off-list but conditioned on a 12-month committed reservation or minimum monthly invoice (preferred).
B) If customer insists on 35% marketplace price we need a documented co-sell commitment from Azure (co-sell credit share) OR offset via Redwood Optimize add-on at +10% MSRP.

I recommend option A — counter at 30% and ask for a signed PO / DocuSign to create the private offer. Karthik, can you confirm operational steps and if the marketplace team can create the private offer with a 30% list price?

Marissa Cole
Director of Sales | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redlined_PO_Northstar_v1.pdf (internal redlines)
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.inference>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Azure private offer + co-sell credit for Northstar — Deal desk recommendation

Team — running this through Deal Desk and finance. Decision and conditions below: 

Decision: APPROVE marketplace private-offer discount up to 30% (exception granted).
Conditions (must be documented before offer creation):
- Customer signs the PO within 7 calendar days (we will use DocuSign link once PO is final).
- Deal to include a 12-month minimum commitment; monthly minimum invoice of $15k to protect unit economics.
- Azure co-sell registration: Marco to provide co-sell registration confirmation email/link to ensure partner crediting.
- Legal to confirm no unusual indemnities in the redlined PO.

Operational notes:
- Marissa/Sean: once PO is signed, I will open a private-offer request with Marketplace Ops and request 30% list price. Azure typically takes 48-72 hours to publish; co-sell credit processing can take additional 2-3 weeks.
- Related links: HubSpot HS-34242 (deal record), DocuSign template ready at https://app.docusign.com/agreements/ABC-1234

Karthik Iyer
Head of Deal Desk | Redwood Inference

Ana Li
